d: The Senior Project Manager is responsible to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic software and IT services engagements for key customers in Saudi Arabia. The role combines delivery leadership, customer relationship management, commercial discipline, and governance. The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for managing complex, business-critical technology projects from initiation through successful delivery and closure, ensuring alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, quality standards, and organizational objectives.

The position requires to provide senior-level leadership to multidisciplinary delivery teams, proactively manage project risks and dependencies, and maintain clear, decision-oriented communication with customer executives and internal leadership.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
A master’s degree in business, technology, or project management is an advantage.
Minimum 10 years of total professional experience in software, technology, digital transformation, or IT services environments.
Minimum 6 years of direct project management experience with accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and customer outcomes.
Proven experience managing complex software development or systems integration projects through the complete lifecycle, from initiation and planning through deployment, acceptance, and closure.
Demonstrated experience managing large enterprise or government customer accounts in Saudi Arabia.
Strong experience within a software development, IT consulting, systems integration, or managed services organization.
Experience leading cross-functional and geographically distributed delivery teams.
Demonstrated exposure to project financials, contract management, change requests, resource planning, and commercial risk.
Experience managing multiple workstreams, vendors, system dependencies, and senior stakeholders.
Previous experience working within STC, government entities, or other major KSA enterprise environments is highly desirable.

d: Senior Sales Supervisor | Kuwait City, Kuwait

Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Almarai Company is ranked as the #1 FMCG Brand in the MENA region and is a market leader in all its categories across the GCC. Almarai currently employs over 46,000 employees servicing some 110,000 retail outlets and has reported net income of SAR 2.04 billion on sales of SAR 19.57 billion in 2023. For more details, please visit our website – www.almarai.com.

An aggressive expansion program together with acquisitions in new vertical markets have created an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic multinational team dedicated to furthering growth plans for the group.

To deliver Company’s growth objective by optimizing the sales & distribution of all Almarai product range in his designated area by strictly adhering to Company policies & procedures and maintaining the highest standards of sales ethics.
q: 3 years Supervisory experience in van sales environment; Experience in system-based sales operation.
